source.publication: 2025 Form 760 Resident Individual Income Tax Instructions (with the 2025 Form 760)
source.section: Form 760 Lines 1-5, 8-9, 11, 12, 14-16; PDF p15 Line 4 Age Deduction and Exemptions; PDF p16 (printed Page 10) Age 65 and Older Deduction Worksheet lines 1-15; PDF p17 (printed Page 11) Taxpayers Age 65 and Older and Line 5; PDF p41 Tax Rate Schedule

worked: Federal (given, not tested): Taxable Social Security (federal worksheet): gross benefits 30,000.00; provisional income = 60,000.00 + half of benefits 15,000.00 = 75,000.00; taxable = 25,500.00. Federal AGI = private pension (you) 40,000.00 + IRA distribution (you) 20,000.00 + taxable Social Security 25,500.00 = 85,500.00. Federal taxable income = 85,500.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 67,750.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 760 Line 1 federal AGI 85,500.00. Line 2 additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 3 = 85,500.00. Age deduction, born on or before January 1, 1939 (you born 1936-03-01): 12,000.00 each with no income test = 12,000.00. Line 4 age deduction = 12,000.00. Line 5 taxable Social Security subtracted = 25,500.00. Line 6 state refund 0.00. Line 7 Schedule ADJ subtractions 0.00. Line 8 = 12,000.00 + 25,500.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 37,500.00. Line 9 VAGI = 85,500.00 - 37,500.00 = 48,000.00. Line 11 standard deduction (Filing Status 1) = 8,750.00. Line 12 exemptions: Section A 1 x 930.00 = 930.00; Section B 1 x 800.00 (65 or older) = 800.00; total 1,730.00. Line 14 = 10,480.00. Line 15 Virginia taxable income = 48,000.00 - 10,480.00 = 37,520.00. Line 16 tax, rate schedule (PDF p41) as numbers: 720.00 + 5.75% x (37,520.00 - 17,000.00 = 20,520.00) = 720.00 + 1,179.90 = 1,899.90 (the form rounds to the whole dollar: 1,900.00). Line 17 Spouse Tax Adjustment: not a joint return, 0.00. Credits none modelled or claimed, 0.00. Virginia income tax = 1,899.90. AFAGI (85,500.00 - 25,500.00 = 60,000.00) is over 50,000, but a person born on or before January 1, 1939 has no income test: the full 12,000.00 applies.
